tagline: Forward-deployed across enterprise clients on an agentic document-credentialing pipeline — a database-backed queue orchestrates parallel verification agents, turning a manual review bottleneck into a same-day recruiter handoff.
companyNote: Centh AI's model: don't rip out the legacy system a company has years of data in — put an agent directly on top of it. The dashboard is just configuration; the agents do the real work.

experiences: Forward-deployed across enterprise clients, owning system design end-to-end by translating live client requirements directly into production build decisions across concurrent client conversations

Engineered an agentic credentialing pipeline from scratch, a database-backed queue orchestrating parallel verification agents (Claude Haiku for LLM checks, Mistral for OCR), processing 800+ documents/day in production with automated recruiter handoff

Shipped a candidate-facing engagement agent coordinating clinical test scheduling and appointment logistics (e.g., TB screenings) ahead of onboarding completion, reducing manual back-and-forth between candidates and recruiters

Extended a 500+ emails/day screening agent with a human-feedback loop updating agent prompts from recruiter corrections; leading consolidation of two production codebases (GCP Python backend and Next.js TypeScript platform) into a unified architecture

tagline: Owned the retrieval and generation path for an AI call assistant surfacing live suggestions mid-conversation — every millisecond of lag was a rep waiting on the model.

highlights.title: Parallelized retrieval
highlights.detail: Concurrent multi-source lookups instead of sequential fetches

highlights.title: Hierarchical chunking
highlights.detail: Layout-aware segmentation that preserved document structure

highlights.title: Hybrid search
highlights.detail: Dense embeddings combined with BM25 keyword matching

highlights.title: Prompt compression
highlights.detail: Context trimmed from 4,900 to 1,950 tokens per call

experiences: Architected an AI-powered call center assistant that provides real-time smart suggestions to representatives based on live transcription analysis, helping agents close deals faster and improve conversion rates
Improved end-to-end suggestion latency from 3.4 seconds to under 1.5 seconds by parallelizing context retrieval and cutting prompt size 60% (4,900 to 1,950 tokens)
Redesigned the retrieval pipeline using layout-aware hierarchical chunking with sparse search, dense vector search, and cross-encoder re-ranking, improving context relevance during live calls
Built event-driven backend services with AWS SAM and CI/CD pipelines, implementing session-based authentication with auto-refresh and multi-tenant RBAC for 50+ concurrent sessions
Reworked authentication architecture by separating authentication and authorization into dedicated middleware, reducing request complexity and improving maintainability using Redis-backed sessions
Implemented production security hardening including webhook signature verification, CORS enforcement, and authorization middleware to prevent injection and scripting attacks
Introduced a company-wide Ruff / ESLint / Prettier setup, improving code consistency and reducing review cycles

tagline: Built an AI assistant platform end-to-end as one of three engineers, from semantic retrieval to the async backend serving it.
experiences: Developed an AI assistant platform using LangChain, OpenAI Embeddings, and Chroma vector store, achieving accurate document retrieval on 500+ internal test queries with semantic search
Redesigned backend by migrating Flask to FastAPI with asynchronous processing and optimized database queries, reducing API latency by 30% through performance testing
Led Agile development in a 3-person team, using Azure DevOps to manage sprints and implementing CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment to AWS
